abstract: We prove $S_{3/10,3/10,3/10}(X)\ll_\varepsilon X^{23/43+\varepsilon}$ for the number of primitive positive integer solutions to $a+b=c\leq X$ satisfying $\text{rad}(a)\leq a^{3/10}$, $\text{rad}(b)\leq b^{3/10}$, and $\text{rad}(c)\leq c^{3/10}$. This improves both the total-budget collision exponent $71/130$ of [7] (by $63/5590$) and the refined total-budget exponent $677/1240$ of [8] (by $591/53320$). It is also below the uniform exponent $34/59$ of Zhang (Zenodo, 29 August 2026), which bounds $S_\rho$ through $S_\rho(X)\le N_{\alpha+\beta+\gamma}(X)$. More generally, we replace the single combined radical budget in the exponent linear program of Bernert, Browning, Lichtman and Teräväinen [3] by three independent coordinate budgets $\rho=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)\in(0,1]^3$ and incorporate the empty-third-modulus collision inequalities of [7]. Exact rational branch certificates and attaining rational points determine the exact optima of both the Fourier-and-geometry relaxation $\mathcal P_0(\rho)$ and the collision-augmented relaxation $\mathcal P_{\text{ss0}}(\rho)$ across a benchmark parameter grid, separating the saving due to independent budgets from the saving contributed by collision constraints. Replaying the leaf multipliers yields a certified three-parameter piecewise affine upper envelope $E(\rho)$, illustrated along the diagonal slice $\rho=(u,u,u)$ in the supplement. All optimization equalities concern the specified finite-dimensional relaxations; attaining points do not provide lower bounds for the arithmetic counting function.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Added a citation to H. Zhang, 'A uniform sub-three-fifths bound for exceptional abc triples', Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22151481 (published 29 August 2026), which proves N_t(X)≪X^{34/59+ε} for 0<t≤1 and hence bounds S_ρ(X) through S_ρ(X)≤N_t(X): two sentences in Section 1, Section 6 comparisons after Theorem 6.1, in Theorem 6.2, after Theorem 6.4 and after Figure 1, the abstract, and new reference [9].
- Theorem 6.1: the definition of the final column now includes the exponent of Zhang's Corollary 1.2 for t≤1, and its entries at (1/4,1/3,5/12) and (1/3,1/3,1/3) are corrected from 7/12 and 283/477 to 34/59; the D_0, D_ss0 and baseline columns are unchanged and the baseline is now described as built from [1]-[6] and [7].
- The central exponent 23/43 and the cube exponent 6043/11180 of Theorem 6.4 are stated to be smaller than 34/59 as well.
- References [7] and [8] now cite version 4 of rStation math_17 and math_28.
- No change to theorems' exponents, proofs, certificates, Figure 1 or the supplement.
title: Separated radical budgets for the Mazur–Kane counting problem
